# Run ledger — P36.37 (row 378): map app shell

**Harness:** devin-desktop/swe-2-high/subagent
**Ticket:** `docs/tickets/378_P36.37__map-app-shell.md` · K1 MAP-03a · `live_verification=false` · gate: none · no OM-20, no production mutation
**Branch:** `r11/P36.37-map-app-shell` ← `r11/P36.36-nojs-map-baseline-and-site-lists` @ `246625f3`
**Owned ids:** SIG-UI-065, SIG-UI-095, SIG-UI-097, SIG-UI-101, SIG-UI-102, SIG-UI-103, SIG-UI-104, SIG-UI-106, SIG-UI-107 · cited SIG-UI-039/040/063, UXR-18/SIG-UI-068, ADR-155/134, SIG-ENG-042

## What landed

- **Preact migration (SIG-UI-097).** `MapIsland.tsx` is a Preact wrapper over
  `src/islands/map/MapApp.tsx` (`client:only="preact"`); `@astrojs/preact@6.0.5`
  + `preact@10.29.8` pinned, React scoped to the three legacy island files via
  `include`. No react chunk reaches `/map/` (verified — the page references
  only the preact renderer client + the island chunk). `runtime-deps.json`
  (`sig.runtime-deps/1`) + `check:runtime-deps` gate the browser allow-list:
  island-graph bare specifiers checked, `/map/` page refs scanned for react,
  vendored dir must hold exactly the pinned three files + manifest.
- **MapLibre ESM split (SIG-UI-106, K1 §6.1).** `scripts/prepare-map-vendor.mjs`
  emits `maplibre-gl.mjs` / `maplibre-gl-shared.mjs` /
  `maplibre-gl-worker.mjs` from the pinned package into
  `web/public/map/vendor/` (gitignored, `sig.map-vendor/1` manifest). The app
  imports the entry over HTTP and pins the worker — the shared chunk is
  fetched once and HTTP-cached for the worker realm (no duplicated worker in
  the island bundle).
- **Merged-style overlays (K1 §2.6).** The overlay sources+layers build once
  (`buildOverlay`) and merge INTO every basemap style document — `setStyle`
  swaps for the basemap → context → plain-background fallback chain keep the
  record layers; a loud notice (`basemap-unavailable`/`basemap-fallback`)
  replaces a silent blank map.
- **App shell:** tabs (In view · Filters · Selected), synchronized in-view
  list (places below z10, ≤50 records from z10 — SIG-UI-102), SIG-UI-101
  selection panel (label, technology, operator-or-not-stated, linked
  jurisdiction, linked sources + licence, first/last seen, precision, status —
  links only when resolvable, UXR-18), facet counts + cannot-apply greys (seen
  greys below z10, no hatch — SIG-UI-104), one-data-hue legend + status
  channels (fill/hollow/ring/dashed — SIG-UI-065/107), keyboard contract
  (capture-phase Enter → list, Escape → clear; pan pad single-pointer —
  SIG-UI-095), `sig.workspace-state/2` round-trips `at`/`basemap`/`layers`/
  `focus`/filters (SIG-UI-103).
- **Committed basemap style repairs (P36.33 artifact defects — never
  rendered before):** `gen-map-styles.mjs` passes `namedFlavor()` to
  `layers()` (a bare string was silently ignored → null colours), repoints
  the emitted `protomaps` source id to the declared `basemap` source, and
  pins `text-font` to the committed stack when upstream emits non-string
  font helpers. Regenerated all three styles; `check:map-styles --verify`
  green.
- **`page-budgets.json`:** the `jsInitialBytes` + `totalInitialMaxBytes`
  measured-gap rows were first removed on a static dist walk that misses
  the runtime-fetched MapLibre chunks; the CI wire measure shows them still
  over the ratified ceilings (482,469 gz / 578,041 gz) — the rows are
  RESTORED with wire-measured regression bounds (524,288 / 600,000, plus a
  national total row at 1,350,000 and a re-recorded national document row
  at 800,000). The `tbtMs` rows stay — they are CI-Lighthouse measures this
  environment cannot re-run honestly; `gen-lhci.mjs` regenerated.
- `check-licenses.mjs`: `WAIVED_PACKAGES` — `caniuse-lite` ships data tables
  (CC-BY-4.0), arrives via `@prefresh/vite`; named-package waiver, not a
  licence carve-out.
- `page-types.ts` notes updated; `CHANGELOG` Unreleased entry; `islands.css`
  route-scoped app styles (token-compliant); `tsconfig` excludes
  `public/map/vendor/**`; `.gitignore` covers the vendored emit.

- `check:lhci` `check:map-styles` `check:licenses` `check:paths` `check:dom`

- `make check` + `npm --prefix web run check` — deferred to the head-bound CI

  Docker down, Node v25 vs `>=24 <25` — CI Node 24 authoritative).

## Fix arc

Preact renderer ambiguity (SSR check swallows errors) → `client:only=
"preact"` matching the existing island pattern · `at=` URL-encoded (`%2F`)
round-trip · Enter swallowed by the renderer's canvas keys → capture-phase
container listener; Enter opens the In-view tab first · `data-drawn`
starvation — `idle` never refires behind a pending remote basemap source;
`setStyle` "Style is not done loading" → merged-style overlays (sources live
inside the style doc) + `sourcedata` latch · upstream basemap emit defects
(bare flavour string → null colours/fonts; `protomaps` source id) →
`namedFlavor()` + source remap + font sanitise · token-lint literals in the
new CSS → `--sig-border-*`/`--sig-space-*` · `geojson` type-only import
mis-flagged by the dep gate · caniuse-lite licence → named waiver.
